A Fe 29.6 Co 26.7 Ni 28.8 Al 7.1 Ti 7.8 (at. %) alloy (FeCoNiAlTi HEA) powder was prepared by a gas atomization method in Ningbo Zhongyuan New Material Technology Co.

The three-dimensional (3D) printing process was carried out by SLM under argon atmosphere in a Hanbang United 3D Technology Co. A layer of 30 - 50 μ m powder was firstly laid on the stainless-steel substrate. Then, a high-power laser melted the metal powders along a predetermined path to form a molten pool so that the molten powder accumulated layer by layer to form a bulk alloy. The processing parameters are summarized in Table 1 .
